author: Plasmic_Mangoes
body: My username is Plasmic_Mangoes, and I was banned by the moderator, Iron for alleged flying. I do not believe that I was flying I was simply lagging slightly and I was glitching a bit so I feel it was a mistake I was banned. Please unban me. Thanks for reading my appeal.
